Topics · Hard times

Is patience just being told to keep quiet?

In the Quran, patience weeps, speaks up when wronged, and may walk away. It is steadiness, not carried alone.

Part 1 of 4

﴿قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ٨٣ وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ٨٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

[Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allāh will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise." And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615]

Translator's notes

[614] i.e., he lost his sight. [615] He did not express the extent of his grief or his anger at what he suspected his sons had done but was patient, depending only upon Allāh for help.

Quran · Yusuf 12:83-84

Translation

May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

Original · Hebrew

וְאֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֗י יִתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם רַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְשִׁלַּ֥ח לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אַחֵ֖ר וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וַאֲנִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכֹ֖לְתִּי שָׁכָֽלְתִּי׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 43:14

World English Bible

Test the idea against the Quran's own example. Jacob has lost one son and now another. He says: beautiful patience. In the very next line he turns away, cries out his sorrow for Joseph, and his eyes go white with grief. Both are in the text, side by side, about one man. So beautiful patience cannot mean dry eyes. If your tears have ever been called weakness, or a lack of faith, the book has set a prophet's tears next to those very words.

A question for you

What has patience been made to mean for you?

If you sayNot crying.
ThenThen Jacob's eyes have something to say to you.
If you sayNot complaining.
ThenThe next part looks at that.
If you sayAccepting anything.
ThenThe part after that looks at this.
If you sayHolding on.
ThenThat is close to the root of the word.

Part 2 of 4

﴿لَّا يُحِبُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْجَهْرَ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allāh Hearing and Knowing.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:148

Translation

If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

Original · Hebrew

אִם־עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽוֹ׃

the Torah (Exodus) · 22:23

World English Bible

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

Quran · Al-Mujadilah 58:1

Translation

I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

Original · Hebrew

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

the Psalms · 142:1-3

World English Bible

Is a wronged person meant to stay silent? The first verse says God does not like harmful words spoken openly, except from one who has been wronged. The exception is written into the rule. The second opens a whole chapter with a woman who came arguing over her husband and complaining to God. The first words are that God heard her. Her complaint is not called a failure of patience, and what follows in the chapter answers her. So if you have been wronged, your voice is not the problem.

A question for you

Has the word patience ever been used to quiet you?

If you sayYes.
ThenThen it was used against what these verses describe. Your voice had a place all along.
If you sayI have used it to quiet someone else.
ThenMany have, meaning well. You can still go back and listen.
If you sayNo, the word has mostly helped me.
ThenThen you have known the word at its best. Keep it.

Part 3 of 4

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say,[1345] "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

Translator's notes

[1345] The Prophet (ﷺ) is instructed to say on behalf of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) to His believing servants.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:10

Translation

For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

Original · Hebrew

כִּֽי־תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה־זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃ וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

Habakkuk · 3:17-18

World English Bible

﴿وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:41

Does patience mean staying where you are being hurt? Look at what sits in the same verse as the patient's reward: God's earth is wide. Many readers took that to mean one may leave. The other verse says there is no blame on those who defend themselves after being wronged. The book praises forgiveness too, as a gift a person may choose. It is not a sentence to stay. If someone is harming you, nothing here asks you to remain. Please speak to someone you trust.

A question for you

Which of these is closest to your situation?

If you sayI am safe, and this is about a loss.
ThenThen the next part is for you.
If you sayI am in a situation that is hurting me.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. The next part will wait for you.
If you sayThis is about someone I care for.
ThenThen you may be the one person they can tell. Listening first may be what helps most.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And be patient, [O Muḥammad], and your patience is not but through Allāh. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:127

Translation

Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

Original · Hebrew

ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ לְקוָֹ֔ו לְנֶ֖פֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶֽׁנּוּ׃ ט֤וֹב וְיָחִיל֙ וְדוּמָ֔ם לִתְשׁוּעַ֖ת יְהוָֽה׃

Lamentations · 3:25-26

World English Bible

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:153

No evil will happen to him who fears the Lord, but in trials once and again he will deliver him.

Sirach · 33:1

World English Bible

So what is patience? Take away the silence, the forced smile and the staying, and something remains: holding steady, and not being alone in it. The first verse says your patience is only through God, so it is nothing you manufacture by force of will. The second speaks of seeking help through patience and prayer, and says God is with the patient. It is closer to a hand held than a wall built. If you have none left today, that is no failure. That is where the verse begins.

A question for you

What do you need most today?

If you sayTo say what happened.
ThenThen say it, to someone safe, or on the line here.
If you sayTo leave, or to begin to.
ThenThat may be a kind of patience too: one long, careful step. Let someone you trust help you plan it.
If you sayTo rest.
ThenRest is allowed. Nothing in these verses says otherwise.
If you sayTo hold on one more day.
ThenThen that is the whole of today's task, and it is enough.
